shortDescription: Haryana HSSC Primary Teacher PRT Result 2026 (Advt. No. 05/2024) – Final / Additional result out on 24 July 2026 for 1456 Mewat Cadre posts. Download PDF at hssc.gov.in.
content:
Haryana Staff Selection Commission (HSSC) has declared the Primary Teacher (PRT) / JBT Result 2026 for Mewat Cadre under Advertisement No. 05/2024.

Total posts: 1456. Written exam was held on 28 September 2024. Result updates include revised result (April 2026) and Final / Additional result on 24 July 2026.

Important dates (cycle)

  • Application: 12–21 August 2024
  • Written exam: 28 September 2024
  • Earlier / revised results: May 2025 / April 2026
  • Final result / additional list: 24 July 2026

How to check

  1. Open https://hssc.gov.in
  2. Go to Result / Notice for Advt. 05/2024
  3. Download Final Result and Additional List for scrutiny of documents (if published)
  4. Search your roll number in the PDF

Selected candidates should follow HSSC instructions for document scrutiny and further appointment process. Use only the official HSSC website.
